summary: Multi-program referral registry plus suspend-zero-cost loop kernel plus single-file-to-modify discipline: referral program as a named object with per-program lifetime, multi-program attribution with per-program expiry and hand-enterable codes, one-payout-per-relationship and self-referral guards as explicit flags; loop waiting that parks with no process and no tokens spent and resumes the exact session; event-sourced loop state with one-command provenance and bad-config-never-stops-the-loop; instruction/data separation as a structural rule; hop-count circuit breaker capping self-re-triggering; single-file-to-modify discipline with fixed time budget per attempt and one pass/fail metric. Patterns from pdazcom/laravel-referrals (MIT) and KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop (MIT); discipline shape from karpathy/autoresearch (ideas only, license unverified).
